findings.fix: Delete these `have heq/hof … ▸` wrappers and use the hypothesis directly (`exact h`, or `simpa [pow_succ] using h` at Kernel/Closure.lean:86); `Matrix.of` is `Equiv.refl`, and `hadamard`/`+`/`•` on matrices are the Pi operations, so no rewrite is needed.
findings.issue: Several added `heq`/`hof` blocks re-derive definitional equalities and then rewrite with them: `Matrix.of L = L` (Limits.lean:87-90, Fourier/Convention.lean:134-138, CharFun/PositiveDefinite.lean:59-63), `Matrix.hadamard A B = fun a b => A a b * B a b` (Kernel/Closure.lean:82-86, SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean:360-366), matrix `+` (SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean:327-333) and `•` (SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean:341-345, BochnerTheorem.lean:223-227). Each is proved by `ext …; rfl` or `simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]`, i.e. the hypothesis already has the target type up to unfolding.

summary: The migration to Matrix.PosSemidef reuses Mathlib correctly and leaves no shadow predicate, but the deleted one-line helpers were re-inlined as copy-pasted boilerplate: the conjugate-symmetry step is duplicated 13 times, the Finset-sum bridge 4 times, and several `heq`/`hof` blocks re-derive `rfl`. One call site also re-derives via `.submatrix` what `charFun_posSemidef` already provides directly.
